description: Check whether a phone/tablet model supports eSIM before recommending a plan. Free-text device name in; compatible yes/no plus closest matches out. IMPORTANT: eSIM hardware support is only HALF the requirement — the phone must ALSO be carrier-unlocked. This tool returns an unlock_required flag + how to verify; always relay it, because a locked phone cannot use a travel eSIM.
name: check_device_compatibility
